# AWS Serverless Three-Tier Web Application — Production Architecture Document

**Version:** 1.0 | **Region:** us-east-1 | **Classification:** Production-Ready

---

## 1. Executive Summary

This document defines the production architecture for a secure, globally scalable, fully serverless three-tier web application on AWS. The architecture eliminates all server management overhead by leveraging exclusively pay-as-you-go managed services while maintaining enterprise-grade security, observability, and compliance posture.

The solution serves static content globally via Amazon CloudFront backed by Amazon S3, processes business logic through AWS Lambda functions exposed via Amazon API Gateway (HTTP API), and persists application data in Amazon DynamoDB — all protected by AWS WAF, Amazon Cognito authentication, and defense-in-depth IAM controls.

**Key Outcomes:**
- **Zero infrastructure management** — all services are fully managed and auto-scaling
- **Pay-per-use cost model** — estimated $46–$78/month at moderate traffic (1M page views, 500K API calls)
- **Global content delivery** — CloudFront edge network with sub-50ms static asset delivery worldwide
- **Defense-in-depth security** — WAF, Cognito JWT auth, least-privilege IAM, KMS encryption, TLS 1.2+ everywhere
- **Full observability** — CloudWatch Logs/Metrics/Alarms, AWS X-Ray distributed tracing, CloudTrail audit logging

### 2.2 Traffic Flow Summary

| Step | Path | Protocol | Security Control |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | User → Route 53 | DNS | DNSSEC optional |
| 2 | Route 53 → CloudFront | HTTPS | TLS 1.2+, WAF inspection |
| 3 | CloudFront → S3 (static) | HTTPS | OAC signing, bucket policy |
| 4 | CloudFront → API Gateway (/api/*) | HTTPS | WAF, no caching, auth header forwarded |
| 5 | API Gateway → Lambda | AWS internal | JWT validation, IAM |
| 6 | Lambda → DynamoDB | TLS (AWS SDK) | IAM execution role, KMS |
| 7 | All services → CloudWatch/X-Ray | AWS internal | IAM |

## 3. Component Details

### 3.1 Presentation Tier

#### 3.1.1 Amazon CloudFront

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Distribution Type | Web |
| Price Class | PriceClass_All |
| Minimum TLS Version | TLSv1.2_2021 |
| Viewer Protocol Policy | Redirect HTTP to HTTPS |
| Origin Protocol (S3) | HTTPS only via OAC |
| Origin Protocol (API GW) | HTTPS only |
| WAF Web ACL | Attached (CLOUDFRONT scope) |
| HTTP/2 + HTTP/3 | Enabled |
| Access Logging | Enabled → `webapp-cf-access-logs-{account-id}` |
| Origin Shield | Enabled (us-east-1) |
| Custom Domain | `yourdomain.com`, `www.yourdomain.com` |
| ACM Certificate | us-east-1, DNS-validated |

**Cache Behavior Configuration:**

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Priority │ Path Pattern │ Origin      │ Cache Policy        │ TTL           │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│    0     │ /api/*       │ API Gateway │ CachingDisabled     │ 0             │
│          │              │             │ AllViewerExceptHost │               │
│          │              │             │ Forward: Auth header│               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│    1     │ /static/*    │ S3 (OAC)    │ CachingOptimized    │ 86400–31536000│
│          │              │             │ Compress: true      │               │
├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Default  │ *            │ S3 (OAC)    │ CachingDisabled     │ 0             │
│          │              │             │ (index.html, SPA)   │               │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Custom Error Responses:
  HTTP 403 → /index.html (HTTP 200) — SPA client-side routing
  HTTP 404 → /index.html (HTTP 200) — SPA client-side routing
```

#### 3.1.2 Amazon S3 — Static Asset Hosting

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Bucket Name | `webapp-static-assets-{account-id}-us-east-1` |
| Static Website Hosting | **DISABLED** — served via CloudFront OAC only |
| Block Public Access | All 4 settings = `true` |
| Versioning | Enabled |
| Encryption | SSE-KMS (webapp-s3-cmk) |
| Object Ownership | BucketOwnerEnforced (ACLs disabled) |
| Server Access Logging | Enabled → `webapp-s3-access-logs-{account-id}` |
| Lifecycle: Non-current versions | Transition to S3-IA after 30 days; expire after 365 days |

**S3 Bucket Policy — Static Assets:**

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowCloudFrontOACOnly",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {
        "Service": "cloudfront.amazonaws.com"
      },
      "Action": "s3:GetObject",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::webapp-static-assets-{account-id}-us-east-1/*",
      "Condition": {
        "StringEquals": {
          "AWS:SourceArn": "arn:aws:cloudfront::{account-id}:distribution/{distribution-id}"
        }
      }
    },
    {
      "Sid": "DenyNonTLS",
      "Effect": "Deny",
      "Principal": "*",
      "Action": "s3:*",
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:s3:::webapp-static-assets-{account-id}-us-east-1",
        "arn:aws:s3:::webapp-static-assets-{account-id}-us-east-1/*"
      ],
      "Condition": {
        "Bool": { "aws:SecureTransport": "false" }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| User Pool Name | `webapp-user-pool` |
| MFA | TOTP + SMS (Optional; ENFORCED recommended for production) |
| Password Policy | Min 12 chars, uppercase + lowercase + numbers + symbols |
| Advanced Security Mode | ENFORCED (compromised credential detection) |
| OAuth Flow | Authorization Code + PKCE |
| Token: Access | 1 hour |

### 3.2 Business Logic Tier

#### 3.2.1 Amazon API Gateway — HTTP API

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| API Type | HTTP API (not REST API — lower cost, lower latency) |
| Protocol | HTTPS only (TLS 1.2+) |
| Stage | `$default` (auto-deployed) |
| Authorizer | Cognito JWT on all protected routes |
| WAF Web ACL | Attached (REGIONAL scope) |
| X-Ray Tracing | Enabled |
| Access Logging | `/aws/apigateway/webapp-api` (90-day retention) |
| Custom Domain | `api.yourdomain.com` |
| Throttling | 10,000 RPS burst / 5,000 RPS steady-state |

**API Route Table:**

```
│ Method │ Path            │ Authorizer    │ Lambda Integration    │ Notes      │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ GET    │ /health         │ None (public) │ HealthCheckFunction   │ Liveness   │
│ GET    │ /items          │ Cognito JWT   │ GetItemsFunction      │ Protected  │

│ GET    │ /items/{id}     │ Cognito JWT   │ GetItemFunction       │ Protected  │
│ PUT    │ /items/{id}     │ Cognito JWT   │ UpdateItemFunction    │ Protected  │
│ DELETE │ /items/{id}     │ Cognito JWT   │ DeleteItemFunction    │ Protected  │
│ GET    │ /profile        │ Cognito JWT   │ GetProfileFunction    │ Protected  │
│ PUT    │ /profile        │ Cognito JWT   │ UpdateProfileFunction │ Protected  │
```

```json
  "IdentitySource": "$request.header.Authorization",
  "JwtConfiguration": {
    "Audience": ["webapp-app-client-id"],
    "Issuer": "https://cognito-idp.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/{user-pool-id}"
  }

```

**CORS Configuration:**

```json

    "https://yourdomain.com",
    "https://www.yourdomain.com"
  ],
  "AllowMethods": ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
```

#### 3.2.2 AWS Lambda — Serverless Compute

**Global Lambda Standards:**

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Runtime | Node.js 20.x or Python 3.12 |
| Architecture | arm64 (Graviton2 — ~20% cost reduction) |
| Memory | 256 MB default (profile and tune per function) |
| Timeout | 29 seconds (API Gateway HTTP API max) |
| X-Ray Tracing | Active (all functions) |
| Environment Variables | Encrypted with KMS CMK |
| Dead Letter Queue | SQS DLQ for async invocations |
| VPC | Not required — DynamoDB accessed via TLS + IAM (no VPC cold-start penalty) |
| Layers | Shared utilities + AWS SDK in Lambda Layer |

**Lambda Function Inventory:**

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Function Name        │ Memory │ DynamoDB Permissions        │ Table          │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ GetItemsFunction     │ 256 MB │ Query, Scan                 │ items-table    │
│ CreateItemFunction   │ 256 MB │ PutItem                     │ items-table    │
│ GetItemFunction      │ 256 MB │ GetItem                     │ items-table    │
│ UpdateItemFunction   │ 256 MB │ UpdateItem                  │ items-table    │
│ DeleteItemFunction   │ 256 MB │ DeleteItem                  │ items-table    │
│ GetProfileFunction   │ 256 MB │ GetItem                     │ users-table    │
│ UpdateProfileFunction│ 256 MB │ UpdateItem                  │ users-table    │
│ HealthCheckFunction  │ 128 MB │ None                        │ N/A            │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

**Sample Least-Privilege IAM Execution Role (GetItemsFunction):**

```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "DynamoDBReadAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "dynamodb:Query",
        "dynamodb:Scan"
      ],
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:{account-id}:table/webapp-items-table",
        "arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:{account-id}:table/webapp-items-table/index/*"
      ]
    },
    {
      "Sid": "CloudWatchLogsAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "logs:CreateLogGroup",
        "logs:CreateLogStream",
        "logs:PutLogEvents"
      ],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:logs:us-east-1:{account-id}:log-group:/aws/lambda/GetItemsFunction:*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "XRayAccess",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": [
        "xray:PutTraceSegments",
        "xray:PutTelemetryRecords",
        "xray:GetSamplingRules",
        "xray:GetSamplingTargets"
      ],
      "Resource": "*"
    },
    {
      "Sid": "KMSDecryptEnvVars",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
      "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:{account-id}:key/{lambda-env-cmk-id}"
    }
  ]
}
```

> **Design Principle:** Every Lambda function has its own dedicated IAM execution role. No two functions share a role. No wildcard (`*`) resource ARNs are used for DynamoDB or S3 actions.

**Access Pattern Matrix:**

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Access Pattern              │ Operation   │ Key Condition          │ Index    │
├──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ Get all items for user      │ Query       │ PK=userId              │ Main     │
│ Get specific item           │ GetItem     │ PK=userId, SK=itemId   │ Main     │
│ Create item                 │ PutItem     │ PK=userId, SK=itemId   │ Main     │
│ Update item                 │ UpdateItem  │ PK=userId, SK=itemId   │ Main     │
│ Delete item                 │ DeleteItem  │ PK=userId, SK=itemId   │ Main     │
│ Lookup item by itemId       │ Query       │ PK=itemId              │ GSI 1    │
│ Get items by status + date  │ Query       │ PK=status, SK>=date    │ GSI 2    │
```

## 4. Security and Operations

### 4.1 Security Architecture — Defense in Depth

```
Layer 1 — Edge:        AWS WAF (CloudFront scope) + CloudFront HTTPS enforcement
Layer 2 — CDN:         CloudFront OAC (S3 access), no direct S3 public access
Layer 3 — Auth:        Cognito JWT tokens, PKCE flow, MFA, Advanced Security Mode
Layer 4 — API:         AWS WAF (Regional scope) + JWT Authorizer on all routes
Layer 5 — Compute:     Least-privilege IAM per Lambda function, no wildcard ARNs
Layer 6 — Data:        DynamoDB SSE-KMS, IAM-only access, no hardcoded credentials
Layer 7 — Transport:   TLS 1.2+ at every tier boundary
Layer 8 — Audit:       CloudTrail multi-region trail, CloudWatch Logs, X-Ray
```

### 4.2 AWS WAF Configuration

**CloudFront WAF Web ACL (CLOUDFRONT scope, us-east-1):**

```
Priority 1:  AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet          → BLOCK  (OWASP Top 10)
Priority 2:  AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet  → BLOCK  (Log4j, SSRF)
Priority 3:  AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList → BLOCK  (Known bad IPs)
Priority 4:  AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet            → BLOCK  (SQL injection)
Priority 5:  AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet           → BLOCK  (Linux exploits)
Priority 6:  RateLimitRule (Custom)
             Limit: 2,000 requests / 5 minutes / IP → BLOCK
Priority 7:  GeoBlockRule (Custom, optional)
             Block specific countries per compliance → BLOCK

Default Action: ALLOW
WAF Logging: Kinesis Data Firehose → S3 (webapp-waf-logs-{account-id})
```

**API Gateway WAF Web ACL (REGIONAL scope, us-east-1):**

```
Priority 1:  AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet          → BLOCK
Priority 2:  AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet  → BLOCK
Priority 3:  AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList → BLOCK
Priority 4:  AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet            → BLOCK
Priority 5:  APIRateLimitRule (Custom)
             Limit: 1,000 requests / 5 minutes / IP → BLOCK

Default Action: ALLOW
WAF Logging: CloudWatch Logs (/aws/waf/webapp-api-waf)
```

### 4.3 Encryption Summary

| Layer | At Rest | In Transit |

#### CloudWatch Alarms → SNS Topic: `webapp-ops-alerts`

```
Lambda Alarms (per function):
  • Errors          > 5 in 5 minutes          → ALARM
  • Duration P99    > 10,000 ms               → ALARM
  • Throttles       > 10 in 5 minutes         → ALARM
  • ConcurrentExec  > 80% of reserved limit   → ALARM

API Gateway Alarms:
  • 5XXError rate   > 1%                      → ALARM
  • 4XXError rate   > 5%                      → ALARM
  • Latency P99     > 5,000 ms                → ALARM

DynamoDB Alarms (per table):
  • SystemErrors    > 0                       → ALARM
  • UserErrors      > 10 in 5 minutes         → ALARM
  • ThrottledRequests > 0                     → ALARM
  • SuccessfulRequestLatency P99 > 50 ms      → ALARM

CloudFront Alarms:
  • 5xxErrorRate    > 1%                      → ALARM
  • 4xxErrorRate    > 5%                      → ALARM
  • TotalErrorRate  > 2%                      → ALARM
```

#### AWS X-Ray Tracing

```
Scope:         Lambda (Active tracing) + API Gateway ($default stage)
Coverage:      Full end-to-end: CloudFront → API GW → Lambda → DynamoDB

X-Ray Groups:
  "HighLatency":  filter = "responsetime > 2"
  "Errors":       filter = "error = true OR fault = true"

Sampling Rules:
  Default:                    5% of all requests
  Write operations (POST/PUT/DELETE): 10% of requests
  Error traces:               100% (always captured)
```

### 4.5 Key Design Decisions and Tradeoffs

| Decision | Choice | Rationale | Future Migration Path |
|---|---|---|---|
| API Gateway type | HTTP API | 71% cheaper than REST API; native JWT authorizer; lower latency | Migrate to REST API if usage plans, API keys, or request transformation are needed |
| Lambda networking | No VPC | Eliminates 100–700ms cold-start penalty from ENI attachment; DynamoDB secured via IAM + TLS | Add VPC + VPC Endpoint if RDS/ElastiCache added |
| DynamoDB capacity | On-demand | Zero capacity planning; instant scaling; pay-per-request | Switch to provisioned + Auto Scaling at sustained >1M req/day for 50–70% cost reduction |
| S3 origin access | OAC (not OAI) | AWS current best practice; supports SSE-KMS; OAI is legacy/deprecated | N/A — OAC is the final standard |
| Deployment scope | Single region | Meets requirements; CloudFront provides global edge; PITR for recovery | Add DynamoDB Global Tables + Route 53 latency routing for multi-region active-active |
| Auth UI | Cognito Hosted UI | Reduces security risk; MFA/Advanced Security built-in; faster time-to-market | Custom UI with Amplify UI components if full branding control required |
| X-Ray sampling | 5% default / 100% errors | Balances cost vs. observability; errors always captured for debugging | Increase to 10–20% if SLA requires tighter P99 tracking |

### 5.2 Deployment Order (Dependency Chain)

```
Step 1: StorageStack
        └── Creates: S3 buckets, KMS CMKs
        └── Outputs: Bucket ARNs, KMS Key ARNs

Step 2: AuthStack
        └── Depends on: StorageStack (KMS)
        └── Creates: Cognito User Pool, App Client, Hosted UI domain
        └── Outputs: User Pool ID, App Client ID, Issuer URL

Step 3: DatabaseStack
        └── Depends on: StorageStack (KMS)
        └── Creates: DynamoDB tables, GSIs, CloudWatch alarms
        └── Outputs: Table names, Table ARNs, GSI ARNs

Step 4: ComputeStack
        └── Depends on: DatabaseStack (table ARNs), StorageStack (KMS), AuthStack (pool ID)
        └── Creates: Lambda functions, IAM execution roles, Lambda Layers
        └── Outputs: Lambda function ARNs

Step 5: ApiStack
        └── Depends on: ComputeStack (Lambda ARNs), AuthStack (JWT config)
        └── Creates: API Gateway HTTP API, JWT Authorizer, WAF Regional WebACL
        └── Outputs: API Gateway endpoint URL

Step 6: CdnStack
        └── Depends on: StorageStack (S3 bucket), ApiStack (API GW endpoint)
        └── Creates: CloudFront distribution, OAC, WAF CloudFront WebACL, Route 53 records
        └── Outputs: CloudFront domain, Distribution ID

Step 7: ObservabilityStack
        └── Depends on: All stacks
        └── Creates: CloudWatch dashboards, composite alarms, X-Ray groups, CloudTrail
        └── Outputs: Dashboard URLs, SNS topic ARNs
```

### 5.4 S3 Asset Deployment Commands

```bash
# Deploy versioned static assets (JS, CSS, images) — long TTL
aws s3 sync ./dist/static s3://webapp-static-assets-{account-id}-us-east-1/static/ \
  --delete \
  --cache-control "max-age=31536000,immutable" \
  --metadata-directive REPLACE

# Deploy index.html — no cache (always fresh)
aws s3 cp ./dist/index.html s3://webapp-static-assets-{account-id}-us-east-1/index.html \
  --cache-control "no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate" \
  --content-type "text/html"

# Invalidate CloudFront cache after deployment
aws cloudfront create-invalidation \
  --distribution-id {DISTRIBUTION_ID} \
  --paths "/*"
```
